name: DSET-any-public-key
note: A key that is not the application's reaches Discord as a PING it refuses, with nothing saying why.

name: DSET-always-patched
note: Every deploy would make Discord PING the service again for a URL already right.

name: DSET-no-second-offer
note: The first PING meeting an old instance would fail the deploy.

name: DSET-no-wait
note: Offers back to back would all meet the same old instance.

name: DSET-wrong-server
note: /mod registered in a server that is the channel's id.

name: DSET-dm-channel-taken
note: A channel in no server would register /mod nowhere.

name: DSET-any-door
note: Any URL, the health door or plain http, would be offered to Discord.

name: DSET-token-in-refusal
note: A refusal printed in a public log would carry the bot's token.

name: DSET-no-user-agent
note: Discord requires its User-Agent shape; without it calls can be refused.

name: DSET-registered-anyway
note: /mod registered against an application Discord will not reach, and the deploy green.

name: DSET-refusal-green
old:
echo "::error::Discord was not pointed at the service - its refusal is above"
            exit 1
new:
echo "::error::Discord was not pointed at the service - its refusal is above"
            exit 0
note: A deploy whose Discord end failed would read green.
